guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

sources.title: Silicon etch depth at different aspect ratios

guides.scope: 原創讀圖工作單；沒有提供完整 DRIE 製程配方或對照量測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original image-reading worksheet; no complete DRIE recipe or controlled measurement dataset is provided.

guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.
